rules.statement: Every document one evaluation reads comes from a single revision (P7).
guards: runtime:DocumentSnapshotViewsTest#a view decides with the revisions it was built from

rules.statement: For one key, installs happen in the order loads started (P6).
Snapshot caches have ttl = null and throw on failed reads; an instance refuses to start when Redis's maxmemory-policy is not noeviction.
guards: cosec-spring-boot-starter:CoSecPipelineAutoConfigurationTest#Redis that may evict snapshots fails startup unless told to warn
